candidates.description: These tokens represent Hindi demonstrative pronouns and oblique case markers (such as "इस" and "उन").
These tokens represent subword units and characters from Hindi script and Hindi-English transliterations.
This vector represents the character 'ष' and its common conjunct forms or vowel-matra combinations in the Devanagari script.
This vector activates common character sequences, word roots, and grammatical markers in the Hindi language.
This feature vector represents terms and subwords related to Hindi directions and directional concepts.
This vector represents low-value integers, primarily two-digit and small three-digit numbers.
This vector activates on Hindi text fragments and specific alphanumeric sequences related to transit or location names.
This feature vector represents common linguistic suffixes and morphemes across multiple scripts.
This feature vector activates Hindi sub-word and character sequences, particularly vowel signs and consonant clusters.
This vector represents Hindi conditional, temporal, and interrogative conjunctions and pronouns.
